sources.note: Reference list contains only Lanesman 2016 (plus the ISO record); no grammar or phonology of AJSL exists in Glottolog (Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology).

sources.citation: No known unopened work. All four descriptive/sociolinguistic items on AJSL (Lanesman 2013; Lanesman & Meir 2012 chapter and sketch; Lanesman 2016) were downloaded open and read; each is silent on stress/prosody. A phonological or prosodic description of AJSL has not been published as far as Glottolog, CLoK, DOAB, OAPEN and archive.org show.
